messages.text: i bought this and today it was off when i looked at it. IT has not come back on at all now. What can i do to replace?
Used the customer-care skill

Sorry, that's frustrating. First thing to rule out is the power supply, a PSU that can't hold up under load looks exactly like this, so try a different outlet and, if you have one, a different PSU or cable and see if it lights up at all.

If it stays dead, it goes through RMA and we send you a return label. Can you give me your order number?
Order Shop···· - i tested the volts out of the psu with a volt meter and it read 12.1v so it is good. I tried and diff psu of same brand/specs and it still did nto come on.
Used the store-orders skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Good testing, that rules out the PSU. A unit that won't power on with two known-good supplies is a hardware fault, so it goes through RMA. Fill in the intake form here and we send you a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse.

One thing I have to ask: was it ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered. And what's the email on Shop···· so I can pull it up?
(email hidden)  i did nto over clock it. When i got it at first it was around 12hts but i actually backed it down to 11.8ths
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Got it, Shop····, the NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s, delivered August 25 to (address hidden). Backing it down to 11.8 isn't overclocking, so you're fine there.

So it's an RMA. Fill in that form with the order number and a short note that it won't power on with two tested PSUs, and we'll send the return label. Once the unit lands at the warehouse, processing takes up to 10 days.

Anything odd before it died, a flicker, a smell, or did it just go dark?
is this a person or ai bot, just so i know

Honest answer: I'm the team's automated first line here, and a person from the team steps in whenever something needs them. Happy to bring Abel or Georges into this chat if you'd rather talk to one of them.

Either way the RMA form is the right next step for the NerdOctaxe. Want me to pull them in?
so if i say the story of how it went when i first noticed it wont help now to tell a bot right?

It does help. Tell me and it goes on the ticket with your order, and the whole chat gets emailed to you when we're done, so you can paste it straight into the RMA form too. Our hardware guy reads it.

If you'd rather tell a person directly, say the word and I'll bring Georges in here now. Otherwise, go ahead, what happened when you first noticed it?

ok, i got an alert thru the devices hook up to discord that it had not had a share in an hour so i went to look at it when i got home and it said something on the screen but i unplugged it bf i notice what it said. I replugged in in and was able to get into the web dash and it was zero on volts anmps, ect. I took off th epower again and looked at it and dusted it a bist then when i replugged it in the fans spun but no screen. The fuse was good i checked.

That's useful, zero volts and amps on the dash then fans spinning with no screen points at the board, not the supply, and you already cleared the fuse and two PSUs.

I've put this in front of JD, who handles the hardware side, with your order and everything you just described. He'll come into this chat.

Meanwhile go ahead and submit the RMA form so the return label is already moving. Nothing is lost either way.
ok send me the lionk to the rma form, I also have a device on the way to me now being shipped. :-(
Handed to the team · Hardware fault beyond product data; wants a replacement and is heading into RMA.

Here's the form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put Shop···· on it and the same detail you gave me. The return label comes back to you by email.

JD has been pinged with all of it, so stay in the chat and he'll jump in here. If you step away, you'll get the answer by email.

And sorry, rough timing with another one inbound. Which order is that one, so I can check it?
this one was my best one

Yeah, 12 TH/s, it was the strongest thing you had running. Losing that one stings more than losing a small one.

Get the form in and we'll get it moving. JD will pick this up here shortly.
i can not copy the link you sent

Here it is on its own line, try a long-press or triple-click on it:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

If it still won't copy, no problem. The full chat gets emailed to (email hidden) once we're done here, link included, so you can open it from there. JD can also send it to you directly when he picks this up.
when i try to drag thru it it moves around like a photo but with a circle w redline thru it

That's the chat window, it treats the link as an image so you can't grab the text. Don't fight it.

Two ways round it: try tapping or clicking it directly, it should open the form. If it won't, leave it. JD will send the form straight to your email when he picks this up, and the whole transcript with the link lands in your inbox when we close out here.

Either way your RMA isn't held up.
ok i will ckeck my email to go from there

That works. Watch (email hidden), and check spam once, ours sometimes lands there.

JD has your order and the full fault description, so you won't have to retype any of it. Keep the NerdOctaxe unplugged until the label arrives.

Sorry again about the unit. We'll get it sorted.
ok thaks.
You're welcome. Hang tight for JD's email, and if anything else comes up with the unit, just come back here.
i will keep it unplugged

Perfect. Keep the PSU and cable with it too, JD may want them checked at the warehouse.

Talk soon.
ok
All set on my side. Take care.
ok ty
Anytime. Good luck with the new one landing.
